review_description: I started my solar journey with one of those door-knocking mobs. After getting a few quotes, I called Solar Power Pro. As soon as Guy saw their quotes, he immediately showed me much margin those quotes were putting on the equipment. He then walked me through all the options he would recommend for my setup and explained where it was best to spend the money and where I could get away with something cheaper.Obviously went ahead with his quote.Installation was very professional and quick. I ended up needing to put a couple of optimisers in which weren't originally part of the quote, but the installer was really thorough in explaining why he was recommending I do it and how much they would be.Overall, I could not recommend them enough (and have done so to many of my friends/colleagues).

Guy was great to work with from start to finish.Guy went through various option's Size, Panel's, Inverters.Gave great info for each product with various options available.Have to say install team are probably the best in the business.Recommend 100% For price and workmanship.

Guy was great to work with from quote stage through to installation.  He was very knowledgeable and timely.  I found his quotes to be the best value at the time i was looking for an installation.The installation workers were professional and respectful.  The team clearly take pride in their work.  During the installation process they were efficient and went the extra effort to make sure the installation was done in the best way possible.I definitely would recommend Guy and his team.

Guy is very informative and is insightful with his knowledge in solar.He and his team are fantastic, they kept me in the loop and with the incremental weather, they were able to get the job done.They are on time and stayed with my install untill it was complete, before they started another job.Again highly recommend and it was a pleasure!!Thankyou again Guy and the team!!
Quoting was great and informative.Team put in great effort and communicated well.Faultless cust svc.
